rule.title: Alternative evidence option required when using credit history for subsidized applicants

rule.exemptions: Subdivision (o) does not limit the ability of the owner of a housing accommodation to request information or documentation to verify employment, to request landlord references, or to verify the identity of a person. [Gov. Code § 12955(o)(2)]

rule.title: Duties when subsidized applicant provides alternative ability-to-pay evidence
rule.requirement: If an applicant elects to provide lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of ability to pay, the housing provider must give the applicant reasonable time to respond with that evidence and must reasonably consider it in lieu of credit history when deciding whether to offer the rental accommodation.
rule.exemptions: Subdivision (o) does not limit the ability of the owner of a housing accommodation to request information or documentation to verify employment, to request landlord references, or to verify the identity of a person. [Gov. Code § 12955(o)(2)]

provisions.summary: Prohibits owner discrimination or harassment based on protected personal characteristics, including source of income.
Prohibits written or oral inquiries concerning protected personal characteristics of persons seeking to purchase, rent, or lease housing.
Prohibits otherwise making unavailable or denying a dwelling based on protected characteristics.
Prohibits using income standards that fail to aggregate co-residents' income on the same basis as married persons.
Requires financial or income eligibility standards to be based only on the portion of rent paid by the tenant when subsidized.
Requires offering applicants the option to submit alternative evidence of ability to pay tenant portion before using credit history.
Requires providing reasonable time to respond and reasonably considering alternative evidence in lieu of credit history.
